text:
maria: Quick ux pass after the design sync. A few distinct nits across Compliance > Retention + Region + KMS. Dropping notes here so eng/product can pick them up.
diego: Thanks. I pushed an updated artboard with three badge treatments (icon-only, short label "BYOK", long label "Customer-managed key"). Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/retention-refresh
asha: Microcopy: avoid saying "we store customer keys" anywhere. Suggest: "Uses customer-managed KMS (metadata only shown)". Legal asked us to avoid "retain" vs "store" ambiguity.
ben: Contrast: current badge fill #F6F8FA with white lock icon = 3.1:1 on AA fail. Recommendation: either darken icon to #1F2937 or add 1px border #E5E7EB. Also test with high-contrast mode.
lucy: Focus order/accessibility: region selector currently gets focus after the retention dropdown even though visually it's first. Screen readers are confused. We should make DOM order follow visual order and ensure tabindex sequence is linear.
maria: Region copy idea: replace "Default region: Automatic" with two-line label: "US West (SFO) — Auto routed" and a secondary caption "Requests served from nearest healthy region". Short form for compact views: "Auto: US West (SFO)".
diego: On narrow widths the long KMS label breaks rows. Propose: show short label in table, full label in details flyout. Also add `aria-label` describing key location: "Key ownership: Customer-managed, region us-west-2".
asha: Security/PII: don't display full ARNs in list. Suggested redaction: show `arn:aws:kms:...:key/••••-a1b2` and tooltip with the last 4 chars only. Audit folks prefer the last 8 for traceability.
ben: Export/CSV note: audit export headers currently: `timestamp,event,actor,details`. Compliance requested an explicit `timestamp_iso` and `timestamp_local` columns so downstream ingestion is unambiguous. Also recommend `kms_key_id_redacted` instead of `kms_key`.
maria: Good catch. For human-readable UI we still show relative times, but exports must use `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss±hh:mm` (ISO-8601 with offset). Add a tooltip on hover with that exact string.
lucy: Example table cell mockup:
```
Aug 02, 2026 — 10:23 AM (PDT)
2 hours ago
```
Tooltip: `2026-08-02T10:23:15-07:00`
asha: Copy sensitivity: replace any UI occurrence of "key material" with "key material (see legal docs)" or simply "key metadata". We should keep "key material" restricted to internal/legal pages.
audit-bot: policy-scan: found phrase "we manage keys" in draft-copy.png line 12. Severity: high. Suggested replacement: "Redwood does not have access to key material." Requires legal sign-off.
diego: UX tradeoff: showing both relative + absolute increases row height. Two options: stacked (two lines) or inline with smaller secondary text. Lina suggested stacked in earlier thread; for dense audit tables prefer inline secondary text.
maria: Action items: 1) Diego to create compact badge variant + tooltip copy (due EOD) 2) Ben to file contrast PR and share token updates (due tomorrow) 3) Lucy to adjust DOM order and run axe checks (PR in review) 4) Asha to confirm exact export headers with compliance + propose final microcopy for KMS fields. I'll coordinate legal sign-off.
diego: I'll also add an example CSV row in the figma notes so compliance can preview.
ben: Small dev note: ensure export includes timezone in header row metadata (e.g., `exported_at_iso`). Some customers ingest headers for resync.
maria: If no objections I'll mark these as blockers for the staging deploy for the retention screens. :white_check_mark:
